section_summary.extract_value: This section describes the demographic data collection procedures for a study conducted in the United Kingdom. Participants provided information on sex, age, ethnicity (based on UK census categories), educational attainment, relationship status, sexual orientation, height, and weight. BMI was computed from self-reported height and weight measurements.
